explain.say: A quadratic can have two answers, one answer, or none at all. Surprising, right? A tiny sum tells you which before you start. It is b squared minus 4ac, called the discriminant, from a word meaning to tell apart. In ax squared plus bx plus c, the a, b and c are the numbers.

explain.say: Look at the two roots group. Take x squared minus 5x plus 6. Here a is 1, b is minus 5, c is 6. b squared minus 4ac is 25 minus 24, which is 1. Positive, so two answers: 2 and 3.

explain.say: Now the one root group. In x squared minus 6x plus 9, b squared minus 4ac is 36 minus 36, which is 0. Zero means just one answer: x is 3. The curve only touches the x axis. Can you check the other one?

explain.say: Now the no real roots group. In x squared plus 1, b squared minus 4ac is 0 minus 4, which is minus 4. Negative! No real number squared gives a negative, so there are no real answers. The curve never reaches the x axis.

explain.say: Super work! Here is why. The discriminant sits under the square root in the quadratic formula. Wow: answers for negative ones exist too, called imaginary numbers, and engineers use them for electricity! Challenge: how many roots has x squared plus 4x plus 4?

faq.a: For ax squared plus bx plus c, the discriminant is b squared minus 4ac. Its sign tells you how many real roots the quadratic has.

faq.q: What does a positive discriminant mean?
faq.a: There are two different real roots, and the curve crosses the x axis twice.

faq.q: What does a zero discriminant mean?
faq.a: There is exactly one real root, sometimes called a repeated root. The curve just touches the x axis.

faq.q: What does a negative discriminant mean?
faq.a: There are no real roots. The curve never meets the x axis.

faq.q: Where does the discriminant come from?
faq.a: It is the part under the square root in the quadratic formula, x equals minus b plus or minus the square root of b squared minus 4ac, all over 2a.

facts: For x² + 4x + 4, the discriminant is 16 − 16 = 0, so there is one repeated root, x = −2.

quiz.say: What is the discriminant of x squared plus 3x plus 2?
quiz.why: b squared is 9 and 4ac is 8, so 9 minus 8 is 1.

wrong.1: 17 adds 8 instead of taking it away.
wrong.2: Minus 1 swaps the order of the subtraction.

quiz.say: A quadratic has a discriminant of minus 7. How many real roots does it have?
quiz.why: A negative discriminant means no real roots.

wrong.1: One root needs a discriminant of exactly zero.
wrong.2: Two roots need a positive discriminant.
